# Hon&Guan

> Hon&Guan is a leading ventilation solutions provider offering a comprehensive catalog of HVAC equipment, inline duct fans, exhaust fans, and grow tent systems with energy-efficient EC motors and smart speed controllers.

Hon&Guan specializes in residential and commercial ventilation products including inline booster fans, exhaust systems, carbon filters, and complete grow tent kits. The company provides tools like CFM calculators to help customers determine proper airflow requirements for their spaces.

## Key Topics

- CFM (Cubic Feet per Minute)
- Inline Duct Fans
- Exhaust Fans
- HVAC Systems
- EC Motor Technology
- Energy-Efficient Ventilation
- Carbon Filters
- Grow Tent Equipment
- Backdraft Dampers
- Ventilation Kits
- Speed Controllers
- PowerDual Series
- VortexFlow Series
- Airflow Solutions
- Duct Accessories
